thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] p99 tail latency spike detected in us-east-1 (svc: redwood-inference-hosted, route: /v1/generate). p95: 320ms -> 780ms, p99: 420ms -> 3.4s. Streaming stalls increased. Possible networking degradation across AZs. Paging on-call: @sanjay.

sanjay: ack - I'm on it. pulling dashboards now. any obvious deploys? @deploy-bot?

deploy-bot: deploy: service/redwood-api started canary rollout at 2026-03-14T09:12Z by olivia (commit abc123). No errors logged.

mira: seeing spike in SYN retransmits on nat-gw-a and nat-gw-c; traceroute shows extra hops. Packet loss ~1.2% cross-AZ. DNS latencies spiking too (~300ms). Streaming clients show stalls at chunk boundaries.

devon: which customers impacted? cs-ally any reports?

cs-ally: Zendata and Pagerify reporting degraded real-time lists and streaming timeouts since 09:11. CS opened tickets INC-423 and INC-424. Severity high.

sanjay: ok mitigation plan: 1) shift heavy streaming traffic from AZ-b to AZ-a via smart-routing, 2) failover NAT for affected subnets, 3) temporarily disable large batch exports, 4) enable model fallback to smaller variant for streaming routes. I'll run steps 1-2.

henry: I'll handle NAT failover. Running `aws ec2 replace-route --route-table-id rtb-0a1b2c3d --destination-cidr-block 0.0.0.0/0 --nat-gateway-id nat-0deadbeef` now.

mira: starting tcpdump on host -> seeing repeated TLS handshake timeouts: SESS_ERR from remote endpoint. dumping sample:
```
10:15:03.123456 IP a.b.c.d > nat  TLS Client Hello
10:15:03.223456 IP nat > a.b.c.d  TCP RST
```

devon: traffic shift executed: updated smart routing policy to prefer AZ-a for streaming routes: `curl -XPOST https://rt-router/api/v1/policies/shift -d '{"route":"stream","prefer":"az-a","weight":100}'` response 200.

sanjay: NAT failover completed. p95 improved to ~250ms, p99 down to ~900ms. Some streaming stalls persist. still seeing tail latency spikes at 99.9th.

henry: we're seeing packet drops on peering links between AZ-b and AZ-c, flagged network team. Raising ticket NET-881.

mira: I think TLS handshake spike is due to retransmissions + DNS timeouts causing client retries. Recommend increasing client-facing retry window and enabling keepalive so fewer handshakes.

olivia: rolling back the canary to previous stable (commit def456) to remove any confounders. `deploy-bot: rollback started`.

deploy-bot: rollback completed at 09:40Z, no new errors.

sanjay: handing off to devon for overnight: summary pinned -> root cause unknown but network packet loss + NAT path instability caused TLS handshake and DNS slowness leading to tail latency & streaming stalls. Mitigations: route shift, NAT failover, rollback. Action items: network team follow-up, postmortem, notify customers with timeline. devon you're on-call now @devon.

devon: taking over. I'll coordinate with net team and CS. adding timeline to ticket INC-423. marking postmortem owner: mira.

cs-ally: I posted updates to Zendata and Pagerify with ETA 2h and interim mitigation steps (switch to batch polling). Customers acknowledged. :white_check_mark: 

mira: collecting traces and pcap for archive. will attach to postmortem. saving relevant links: https://dashboards/redwood/incident/1768604321

sanjay: thanks all. closing the paging rotation. please add any follow-ups here.
